description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Ekko''' throws a temporal grenade in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit.
description.text: Active: Ekko throws a temporal grenade in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit.

description2.raw: At 700 units or upon hitting an enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]], the grenade slows down for 1.75 seconds to gradually expand into a ''Temporal Sickness'' field that [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slows]] nearby enemies, travelling for another 190 units.
description2.text: At 700 units or upon hitting an enemy champion, the grenade slows down for 1.75 seconds to gradually expand into a Temporal Sickness field that slows nearby enemies, travelling for another 190 units.

description3.raw: Afterwards, the grenade contracts and homes back to '''Ekko''' at an increased speed, dealing magic damage to enemies hit.
description3.text: Afterwards, the grenade contracts and homes back to Ekko at an increased speed, dealing magic damage to enemies hit.

description4.raw: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''
description4.text: Enemies can be hit only once per pass.
